description.value: The Alpenhorn Bistro & Bar is a locally owned pub-style restaurant on Main Street in downtown Smithers, run since 2010 by an Austrian-trained chef whose menu features European-inspired dishes alongside craft beers and a full bar. The property sits on the site of The Bulkley Hotel, originally built in 1913 and the town's first licensed establishment, giving it an unusually deep connection to Smithers history. An outdoor summer patio and The Bulkley Rental Suites located directly above the restaurant make it a combined dining and accommodation option in the heart of the Bulkley Valley.

address.value: 1261 Main Street, Box 3688 Smithers, BC V0J 2N0
